استرخصن (form X)
# اِسْتَرْخَصْنَ (istarḵaṣna) /is.tar.xasˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَرْخَصَ (istarḵaṣa)
# اُسْتُرْخِصْنَ (usturḵiṣna) /us.tur.xisˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْخَصَ (istarḵaṣa)
# اِسْتَرْخِصْنَ (istarḵiṣna) /is.tar.xisˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْخَصَ (istarḵaṣa)
